source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-8

procedures.title: Speedometer driven gear and seal: replace (three-speed)
parts: lock plate bolt and lock washer
steps: Remove the lock plate bolt and lock washer from the extension, then the lock plate.
Put a screwdriver in the lock plate slot of the fitting and pry the fitting, gear and shaft out of the extension.
Pry the O-ring out of the fitting groove and fit a new one.
Coat the O-ring and driven gear shaft with transmission lubricant and insert the shaft.
Hold the assembly with the fitting slot facing the lock plate boss on the extension and insert it.
Push the fitting in until the lock plate can enter the groove, then bolt the lock plate to the extension.

procedures.title: Extension oil seal: replace (three-speed)
steps: Remove the propeller shaft (Section 4) and anything else in the way.
Pry the old seal out of the extension.
Clean the counterbore with solvent and check it for damage.
Lubricate between the new seal's lips, coat its outside diameter with Permatex or equivalent, and start it squarely in the extension bore.
Drive it in with tool J-5154 until its flange bottoms on the extension.
Refit the propeller shaft and anything removed for clearance.
